title: 3 Dragon Ball Super Arcs That Still Need Anime Adaptation
content: Two decades after concluding the original Dragon Ball manga, Akira Toriyama returned with the Dragon Ball Super manga. Illustrated by Toyotaro, the story takes place a few years after the Buu Saga, where Goku and his friends are living peaceful lives with their families.
author: ComicBook

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The staff for the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga announced on Monday that the series is getting a second season. Crunchyroll revealed that it will stream the second season.
author: ANN

title: Witch Hat Atelier Season 2 Announced
content: Witch Hat Atelier Season 2 anime was announced immediately after the first season’s finale aired in Japan today. The anime ran for a total of 13 episodes, ending with a cliffhanger during Agott and Richeh’s test.
author: Anime Corner

title: Satosumi Takaguchi Launches New Manga Diamond's Blues
content: Kadokawa 's Comic Bridge online manga magazine launched on June 24 Satosumi Takaguchi 's new manga titled Diamond's Blues: Konami Tsukushi to 7-nin no Ojisan (Diamond's Blues: Konami Tsukushi and the Seven Middle-Aged Men).
author: ANN

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia New Trailer Reveals Queen Bee Ending Theme "STAR"
content: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia revealed a new pre-broadcast trailer, confirmed Queen Bee will perform the ending theme, and revealed new key art ahead of its July 4 premiere. title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime's New Promo Video Unveils Queen Bee Ending Song
content: The staff for Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga started streaming a new promotional video on Monday. The video reveals and previews the ending theme song "Hoshi" (Star) by Queen Bee .
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Action Anime of 2026 Gets a Chilling New Trailer Ahead of Its Summer Return
content: The Spring 2026 anime season has come to an end, and a new wave of anime is set to kick off in the Summer season. The upcoming lineup will include many new series as well as returning favorites with new seasons.
author: ComicBook

title: Fist of the North Star Anime Confirms Cour 2 for 2027
content: Warner Bros Japan has confirmed that Fist of the North Star: Hokuto no Ken will return with Cour 2 in 2027, along with a teaser trailer for the second part. Warner Bros also confirmed Record of Ragnarok Season 4 .
author: Anime Corner

title: Top 3 Anime of Spring 2026, Ranked by Their Finales
content: The Spring 2026 season has come to an end, and so have many of the great anime that aired during it. This season saw the return of several beloved series with new seasons, while also introducing many new debuts.
author: ComicBook
